displayIdentity.body: Reconciliation becomes message and entrusted appeal. But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation; For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
